## States

| Bit | State | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `disabled` | Present but not operable; actions other than `read` are refused. |
| 1 | `focusable` | Can receive keyboard focus. |
| 2 | `focused` | Has keyboard focus. |
| 3 | `hovered` | A pointer is over it. |
| 4 | `pressed` | Being pressed (pointer or key held). |
| 5 | `checked` | On: a checkbox, switch, toggle button or checkable menu item. |
| 6 | `mixed` | Neither checked nor unchecked (a tri-state checkbox). |
| 7 | `selected` | Selected within its container (an option, a tab, a list item). |
| 8 | `expanded` | Its controlled content is shown (a disclosure, a combo box, a tree item). |
| 9 | `collapsible` | Can be expanded or collapsed; `expanded` tells which. |
| 10 | `busy` | Being updated; its content may change soon. |
| 11 | `hidden` | Not shown (kept in the tree for virtualised or off-screen content). |
| 12 | `offscreen` | Outside the visible area of its scroll container. |
| 13 | `invalid` | Its value fails validation. |
| 14 | `required` | Must have a value before the form it belongs to is submitted. |
| 15 | `readonly` | Its value can be read and selected but not changed. |
| 16 | `editable` | Its text can be edited. |
| 17 | `multiline` | A text field that accepts line breaks. |
| 18 | `multiselectable` | A container in which several items can be selected. |
| 19 | `modal` | A dialog that blocks the rest of the application. |
| 20 | `default` | The default button of its dialog or form. |
| 21 | `visited` | A link that has been followed. |
| 22 | `animating` | Moving; bounds and values given are those of the target state. |
| 23 | `removing` | Leaving the tree (exit animation); accepts no actions (S-4). |

## Effects

| Effect | Tier | Needs an answer | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `read` | 0 | no | Observes state and changes nothing. |
| `reversible` | 1 | no | Changes state in a way the user can undo (typing, moving, toggling). |
| `irreversible` | 2 | yes (S-1) | Changes state in a way that cannot be undone (deleting, sending, paying). Needs an answer (S-1). |
| `external` | 2 | yes (S-1) | Reaches outside the application (opens a link, starts a program, uses the network). Needs an answer (S-1). |

## Origins

| Origin | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `app` | Written by the application's authors (labels, messages). |
| `user_content` | Entered by a user (a note, a message being written). |
| `remote` | Received from elsewhere (a web page, an e-mail, a model's output). |

## Actions

| Action | Default effect | Arguments | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activate` | `reversible` | — | Do what the element is for: press a button, follow a link, choose an option. |
| `focus` | `read` | — | Move keyboard focus to the element. |
| `blur` | `read` | — | Remove keyboard focus from the element. |
| `toggle` | `reversible` | — | Flip the checked state of a checkbox, switch or toggle button. |
| `set_value` | `reversible` | value: any | Replace the value (a slider's number, a text field's text, a select's choice). |
| `increment` | `reversible` | — | Step the value up. |
| `decrement` | `reversible` | — | Step the value down. |
| `expand` | `reversible` | — | Show the controlled content. |
| `collapse` | `reversible` | — | Hide the controlled content. |
| `select` | `reversible` | — | Select the element within its container. |
| `deselect` | `reversible` | — | Remove the element from its container's selection. |
| `dismiss` | `reversible` | — | Close a dialog, menu, popup or tooltip without choosing. |
| `open_menu` | `read` | — | Open the element's context menu. |
| `scroll_into_view` | `read` | — | Scroll the containers so the element is visible. |
| `scroll_to` | `read` | x: f64 \| end \| page \| -page, y: f64 \| end \| page \| -page | Scroll a scroll view to a content offset: a distance, or `end`, `page`, `-page`. |
| `scroll_by` | `read` | dx: f64 \| page \| -page, dy: f64 \| page \| -page | Scroll a scroll view by a distance, or by `page` / `-page`. |
| `set_selection` | `read` | anchor: i64, focus: i64 | Set the text selection of a text field (grapheme offsets). |
| `replace_selection` | `reversible` | text: string | Replace the selected text of a text field (typing, pasting). |
| `move_to` | `reversible` | x: f64, y: f64 | Move a positioned item (a canvas item, a paddle) to a point. |
| `resize` | `reversible` | height: f64, width: f64 | Resize a positioned item. |
| `seek` | `read` | time: f64 | Move a timeline's playhead to a time in seconds. |

## Extensions

| Extension | Version | Requires | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OMUI_EXT_ime` | 1 | — | Input methods: pre-edit text, candidate window position, commit. |
| `OMUI_EXT_instanced_draw` | 1 | — | Many copies of one primitive in a draw (canvases). |
| `OMUI_EXT_render_to_texture` | 1 | — | Layer caching: render a subtree once, composite it many times. |
| `OMUI_EXT_shader_effect` | 1 | `OMUI_EXT_render_to_texture` | Slang effect shaders on nodes and layers, parameters as typed properties. |
| `OMUI_EXT_gpu_node` | 1 | — | A node that draws itself inside the render pass. |
| `OMUI_EXT_external_texture` | 1 | — | Textures produced outside openmui: video frames, windows, engine views. |
| `OMUI_EXT_canvas` | 1 | — | Canvas semantics: spatial queries, viewport actions, virtualised items. |
| `OMUI_EXT_native_handle` | 1 | — | Native window and device handles (not portable). |
| `OMUI_EXT_host_render_pass` | 1 | — | Draw inside a render pass the host owns (engines). |
| `OMUI_EXT_video` | 1 | — | Compositions rendered to video frames by a render clock. |
| `OMUI_EXT_backdrop_effect` | 1 | `OMUI_EXT_shader_effect` | Effects that read what lies under their layer, frosted alike on every renderer (liquid glass). |
| `OMUI_EXT_style_pack` | 1 | `OMUI_EXT_shader_effect` | Style packs: tokens and effects by window, type and role; the semantic tree unchanged. |
| `OMUI_EXT_frame_pacing` | 1 | — | Frame demand: frames as often as they are wanted, evaluated at their presentation time. |

## Profiles

| Profile | Script languages | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `full` | ts, python, lua | The desktop distribution: every Core component, every script language. |
| `mobile` | ts, lua | Phones and tablets; Python optional. |
| `embedded-linux` | at least 1 | Embedded Linux with a display; at least one script language (Lua recommended). |
| `mcu` | none required | Microcontrollers: retained mode, no script language required (Wasm when needed). |
| `engine` | none required | Inside a game engine, beside the engine's own scripting. |
| `headless` | none required | Tests, agents and video rendering: no display. |

### Easing curves

| Curve | Definition |
|---|---|
| `cubic_bezier` | CSS cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2), x1 and x2 in [0, 1]: solve x(s) = t by 8 Newton steps (stop when \|error\| < 1e-12, abandon when \|x'(s)\| < 1e-9 or s leaves [0, 1]), else 52 bisection steps; the value is y(s) |
| `in_back` | c3·t^3 - c1·t^2, c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1 |
| `in_bounce` | 1 - out_bounce(1 - t) |
| `in_circ` | 1 - √(1 - t^2) |
| `in_cubic` | t^3 |
| `in_elastic` | -2^(10t - 10)·sin((10t - 10.75)·2π/3) |
| `in_expo` | t = 0 ? 0 : 2^(10t - 10) |
| `in_out_back` | c2 = c1·1.525; t < 0.5 ? (2t)^2·((c2 + 1)·2t - c2) / 2 : ((2t - 2)^2·((c2 + 1)·(2t - 2) + c2) + 2) / 2 |
| `in_out_bounce` | t < 0.5 ? (1 - out_bounce(1 - 2t)) / 2 : (1 + out_bounce(2t - 1)) / 2 |
| `in_out_circ` | t < 0.5 ? (1 - √(1 - (2t)^2)) / 2 : (√(1 - (-2t + 2)^2) + 1) / 2 |
| `in_out_cubic` | t < 0.5 ? 4t^3 : 1 - (-2t + 2)^3 / 2 |
| `in_out_elastic` | t < 0.5 ? -(2^(20t - 10)·sin((20t - 11.125)·2π/4.5)) / 2 : 2^(-20t + 10)·sin((20t - 11.125)·2π/4.5) / 2 + 1 |
| `in_out_expo` | t < 0.5 ? 2^(20t - 10) / 2 : (2 - 2^(-20t + 10)) / 2 |
| `in_out_quad` | t < 0.5 ? 2t^2 : 1 - (-2t + 2)^2 / 2 |
| `in_out_quart` | t < 0.5 ? 8t^4 : 1 - (-2t + 2)^4 / 2 |
| `in_out_quint` | t < 0.5 ? 16t^5 : 1 - (-2t + 2)^5 / 2 |
| `in_out_sine` | -(cos(π·t) - 1) / 2 |
| `in_quad` | t^2 |
| `in_quart` | t^4 |
| `in_quint` | t^5 |
| `in_sine` | 1 - cos(t·π/2) |
| `linear` | t |
| `out_back` | 1 + c3·(t - 1)^3 + c1·(t - 1)^2 |
| `out_bounce` | n1 = 7.5625, d1 = 2.75; piecewise parabolas at 1/d1, 2/d1, 2.5/d1 |
| `out_circ` | √(1 - (t - 1)^2) |
| `out_cubic` | 1 - (1 - t)^3 |

| `out_expo` | t = 1 ? 1 : 1 - 2^(-10t) |
| `out_quad` | 1 - (1 - t)^2 |
| `out_quart` | 1 - (1 - t)^4 |
| `out_quint` | 1 - (1 - t)^5 |

| `steps` | CSS steps(n, jump-start \| jump-end \| jump-none \| jump-both) |

### Spring

| Clause | Definition |
|---|---|
| critical | \|ζ - 1\| ≤ 1e-9: x = target + e^(-ω0·t)·(A + (v0 + ω0·A)·t) |
| equation | m·x'' + c·x' + k·(x - target) = 0 |
| frequency | ω0 = √(k/m) |
| interrupt | retargeting at time t starts a new segment from x(t) and v(t) of the current one: position and velocity are continuous |
| over | ζ > 1 + 1e-9: x = target + C1·e^(r1·t) + C2·e^(r2·t), r1,2 = -ω0(ζ ∓ √(ζ² - 1)), C1 = (v0 - r2·A)/(r1 - r2), C2 = A - C1 |
| ratio | ζ = c / (2√(k·m)) |
| response | response r and bounce b: ω0 = 2π/r, ζ = b ≥ 0 ? 1 - b : 1/(1 + b), m = 1 |
| rest | settled from the first time the envelope bounds \|x - target\| ≤ delta and \|v\| ≤ speed (delta = speed = 1e-3 by default); from then on x = target and v = 0 exactly |
| under | ζ < 1 - 1e-9: x = target + e^(-ζω0·t)·(A·cos(ωd·t) + B·sin(ωd·t)), ωd = ω0√(1 - ζ²), A = x0 - target, B = (v0 + ζω0·A)/ωd |

## Core component contracts

### `button` (role `button`)

Performs an action when activated.

| Property | Type | Default | Bindable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | bool | false |  |  |
| `icon` | string | "" |  | An icon token shown before the label. |
| `text` | string | "" | yes | The label, also the accessible name. |
| `variant` | `primary` \| `secondary` \| `ghost` \| `danger` | `secondary` |  |  |
| `verb` | string | "" |  | The verb activation invokes; its effect classifies `activate`. |

| Event | Arguments | Coalesced |
|---|---|---|
| `activated` | — |  |

| Action | Effect | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `activate` | `reversible` | — |

Keys: `Enter|Space` → `activate`

### `checkbox` (role `checkbox`)

A checkable option; can be indeterminate.

| Property | Type | Default | Bindable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | bool | false | yes |  |
| `disabled` | bool | false |  |  |
| `indeterminate` | bool | false |  |  |
| `label` | string | "" |  |  |

| Event | Arguments | Coalesced |
|---|---|---|
| `changed` | checked: bool |  |

| Action | Effect | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `activate` | `reversible` | — |
| `toggle` | `reversible` | — |

Keys: `Space` → `toggle`

### `dialog` (role `dialog`)

A window over the application; modal by default.

| Property | Type | Default | Bindable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `modal` | bool | true |  |  |
| `open` | bool | false | yes |  |
| `title` | string | "" |  |  |

| Event | Arguments | Coalesced |
|---|---|---|
| `closed` | result: string |  |

| Action | Effect | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `dismiss` | `reversible` | — |

Keys: `Escape` → `dismiss`

### `image` (role `image`)

A raster or vector image; `alt` is its accessible name.

| Property | Type | Default | Bindable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` | string | "" |  | Text alternative; empty marks the image decorative (role none). |
| `fit` | `contain` \| `cover` \| `fill` \| `none` \| `scale_down` | `contain` |  |  |
| `source` | string | "" |  | A path, a resource name or a data URI. |

| Event | Arguments | Coalesced |
|---|---|---|
| `failed` | reason: string |  |
| `loaded` | height: i32, width: i32 |  |

### `list` (role `list`)

A list of items, virtualised: only the visible items exist as nodes, the rest answer queries (S-7).

| Property | Type | Default | Bindable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `estimate` | f64 | 32 |  | Estimated item height before measuring. |
| `model` | string | "" |  | The model whose rows are the items. |
| `selectable` | `none` \| `single` \| `multiple` | `none` |  |  |
| `selected` | list<string> | [] | yes |  |

| Event | Arguments | Coalesced |
|---|---|---|
| `activated` | key: string |  |
| `changed` | selected: list<string> |  |

| Action | Effect | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `scroll_to` | `read` | x: f64 \| end \| page \| -page, y: f64 \| end \| page \| -page |

Keys: `Down` → `next`, `Up` → `previous`

### `menu_item` (role `menu_item`)

A command of a menu.

### `scroll_view` (role `scroll_view`)

A viewport onto content larger than itself.

| Property | Type | Default | Bindable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `horizontal` | bool | false |  |  |
| `vertical` | bool | true |  |  |
| `x` | f64 | 0 | yes | Horizontal content offset. |
| `y` | f64 | 0 | yes | Vertical content offset. |

| Event | Arguments | Coalesced |
|---|---|---|
| `scrolled` | x: f64, y: f64 | per frame |

| Action | Effect | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `scroll_by` | `read` | dx: f64 \| page \| -page, dy: f64 \| page \| -page |
| `scroll_to` | `read` | x: f64 \| end \| page \| -page, y: f64 \| end \| page \| -page |

Keys: `End` → `scroll_to(0, end)`, `Home` → `scroll_to(0, 0)`, `PageDown` → `scroll_by(0, page)`, `PageUp` → `scroll_by(0, -page)`

## C ABI functions

| Function | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `omuiCreateRuntime` | Creates a runtime. |
| `omuiDestroyRuntime` | Destroys a runtime and everything it owns. |
| `omuiEnumerateExtensions` | Two-call idiom: props NULL sets count; otherwise fills up to count. |
| `omuiMount` | Mounts a view document (view.schema.json) at a slot, replacing what was there (reconciled). |
| `omuiUnmount` | Removes the view at a slot. |
| `omuiFind` | The node whose id matches the selector (an id path, or a query JSON); the first in tree order. |
| `omuiGet` | A property's value, as JSON, to the sink. |
| `omuiSet` | Assigns properties as one batch, applied at the next frame boundary. |
| `omuiOn` | Subscribes to an event of a node; high-frequency events are coalesced per frame. |
| `omuiOff` | Ends a subscription. |
| `omuiSignalCreate` | Creates a signal. |
| `omuiSignalSet` | Writes a signal; dependants update at the next frame boundary. |
| `omuiSignalGet` | A signal's value, as JSON. |
| `omuiBind` | Binds a property to a signal (two-way when the property is bindable). |
| `omuiRegisterVerb` | Registers an application verb. |
| `omuiInvoke` | Invokes a verb; the sink receives its envelope. |
| `omuiFrame` | Runs one frame of a host-driven runtime (headless, engines). |
| `omuiSnapshot` | The semantic tree, or the part a query selects, as JSON (bus interface `snapshot`). |
| `omuiAct` | Performs an action (bus interface `act`); OMUI_NEEDS_ANSWER when an answer is missing (S-2). |
| `omuiWait` | Waits for a condition (bus interface `wait`), running frames of a headless runtime meanwhile. |
| `omuiPost` | Runs fn on the runtime's thread at the next frame boundary; callable from any thread. |
| `omuiCheck` | Checks a view document against what is registered; the sink receives one JSON diagnostic per line. OMUI_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT when there is an error. |
| `omuiDefineComponent` | Defines (or redefines) the component of a document with an interface; the sink receives its diagnostics. |
| `omuiSignalFind` | The signal a view mounted at a slot declares, by name: what a binding's own signal object refers to. |
| `omuiSignalWatch` | Calls fn after each batch that changed the signal; omuiOff ends it. |
| `omuiRun` | Shows a runtime created without `headless` in a window and runs it until the window closes; OMUI_ERROR_EXTENSION_NOT_PRESENT where no display host is linked. |
| `omuiSignalShare` | Names a signal for view documents, which declare it with "provided": true: one state for the binding's code and every view. A view's own events (`emit`) reach omuiOn on the slot's root node. |
| `omuiModelSplice` | Replaces `remove` rows of a model at `from` with rows_json ([{"key": …, fields…}]), as one change: push, insert, patch, remove and clear in one call. Keys are ids (S-8), unique in the model. |
| `omuiModelRows` | A model's rows [from, from + count), as JSON ([{"key": …, fields…}]). |
| `omuiCatalog` | The registered components, as JSON: each one's contract (properties with their type, default and whether they bind two-way; events with their arguments; actions with their effect), and the properties and events every node has. Bindings build typed builders from it; agents read it. |
| `omuiNativeCatalog` | The native modules the program registered (component-binding §8), as JSON: each module's records, and its functions with their parameters, return type, effect and whether scripts may await them. Bindings make their native modules from it. |
| `omuiNativeCall` | Calls a native module's function on the calling thread (any thread: it touches no runtime state). The arguments are a JSON list in the contract's order or an object by name, and are checked against the contract; the sink receives an envelope with the result as data, or an error record (invalid-argument, not-found, failed). |
| `omuiTheme` | Composes a theme from the program's theme library and gives it to the runtime: a JSON list, a theme then overlays (["dark", "compact", "reduced_motion"]). Every component follows on the next frame; the semantic tree is the same. A name no theme file declares is not found; a composition that cannot be made is an invalid argument; either way the sink receives why and the theme stays. |
| `omuiThemes` | The program's themes and overlays and the runtime's composition, as JSON: {"themes": ["dark", "light"], "overlays": ["compact"], "current": "dark+compact", "dark": true}. |
